data.content_ref: inline:The contradiction is undermined by its own refutation condition being satisfied: SRC_001's distinguishing criterion is already framed as rate-of-checklist-rule-invocations during retrospective analysis (a process trace), not as same-distribution outcome decorrelation. SRC_002 attacks a within-evaluation decorrelation criterion that SRC_001 does not actually advance, so the two targets are addressing different mechanisms. The claimed contradiction is a strawman.
